$comment: Tempo Sniper (OS Estelle model; data-mined GA_SniperShot / GA_BlinkShot / Proj_BlinkShot / GA_Volley / Proj_Volley 2026-11-07, wiki for names). Ice Beam = Piercing Shot (0.4 s wind-up, 10 s; a line ~1000 long, 120 wide, hits everyone in it: 1350+185 % core, 185+92.5 % KB and dmg). Ice Shard = Rose Warp (17 s; blink ~400, then a crystal thorn at 1600/s homing on the nearest enemy or the Core within 700: 1260+140 % core, 140+70 % KB and dmg). Blizzard = Crystal Thorns (22 s, 0.15 s wind-up; 7 LIGHT thorns in a 35 degree cone at 1800/s, ~850 range, each target hit once per volley: 1240+130 % core, 130+65 % KB and dmg). Player knockback = OS x 1.875; power % -> powerRatio.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.desc: Wind up, then fire a long freezing beam that hits every enemy (and the ball) in a line.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.desc: Blink a short way, then fire an ice shard that homes in on the nearest enemy or the ball. It never misses.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.desc: Fire a fan of 7 icicles (LIGHT). Each enemy can only be hit by one of them.
